findings.title: XSS via location.hash
findings.impact: The `location.hash` is a source that can be controlled by the attacker via the URL. The `innerHTML` sink is vulnerable to XSS when the `location.hash` contains malicious content. This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary HTML into the page.
findings.remediation: Use a safe method to handle the hash, such as sanitizing the hash before setting it to `innerHTML` or using a different DOM manipulation technique that doesn't allow arbitrary HTML injection.
